releaseNotes:
WhatsApp Automation Hub - send reminders, receipts and documents to clients from your own number, with a full dispatch audit log.
Redesigned Software Settings, role-based access, and one-click Light/Dark theme switching.

Important fix: schema updates no longer stop at the first failure. On some installs this silently blocked every later database change and showed 'Invalid column name CreatedByUserID' on the dashboard. Your database repairs itself the first time this version runs.

Also fixed: tasks you assign to someone else stay visible to you; compliance tasks stay visible to the whole office; Admin now sees the full firm-wide task list in Workload and Dashboard; task titles now show the Client ID, plus GSTIN on GST tasks and TAN on TDS tasks; portal fetch no longer crashes with 'Only a single ContentDialog can be open'.
